decisions.reason: The cited stable-corner and Whittaker interfaces do not establish the asserted double-cut transport of Spechts and residue maps. Step 3.2 now constructs an admissible stable model with exactly the same roots m and proves equality of the content algebra and residue bimodules from the unchanged presentation and unique regular spectral projectors; step 4.2 proves finite-I unitality directly from strict-column entry multiplicities. No categorical cut equivalence is needed.

Clause (iii), Proof 1.2 and the final step falsely require J and K to be unequal. For two height-one columns with entries 0,1, J=S_1 x S_1 and the stabilizer K of the sorted distinct entries are both the identity subgroup. The repair states their different defining roles, allows equality, and gives this counterinstance; every sorting, KL, inverse-chart and composition-multiplicity formula is preserved.
